metrics.parent_WS: ResourceObserver.process_snapshot parent GetProcessMemoryInfo WorkingSetSize; each sample timestamp coverage
metrics.parent_peak_WS: OS PeakWorkingSetSize lifetime peak at successful query, last_good_memory parent stamp; final parent tail remains uncovered
metrics.child_WS: same API on exact creation handle
metrics.child_peak_WS: same lifetime peak if final query succeeds; after-exit memory may UNKNOWN
metrics.PrivateUsage: private committed bytes, distinct from resident Working Set
metrics.job_peak: PeakJobMemoryUsed/PeakProcessMemoryUsed COMMITTED_BYTES; no current JobMemoryUsage obtained

peak_arithmetic.sample_pair: max sampled WSparent(t_parent)+WSchild(t_child) is asynchronous observation; not exact simultaneous peak
peak_arithmetic.conservative: if complete lifetime peaks Pparent/Pchild independently proved/observed, sup_t(WSparent+WSchild)<=Pparent+Pchild; label CONSERVATIVE_AGGREGATE_UPPER_BOUND
peak_arithmetic.limitations: shared resident pages counted in each process; sum not unique physical memory; current final whole-life peaks unavailable

coexistence: see R46_PIPE_RAW_BASE64_CAPACITY memory_coexistence plus policy/JSON/SHA/runtime/Child objects; memory allocation can precede len/cap enforcement

enforcement.current: cooperative OS lifetime peak threshold check after sampling; parent not in owned Job; optional Child/Job commit quota requires approved values
enforcement.detect_vs_prevent: a rejected peak query occurs after allocation; no proved hard WS bound; native calls can delay next sample
